title: Graph4BiLO: Graph Neural Network Approximation for Bilevel Mixed-Integer Linear Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.30103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bilevel mixed-integer linear optimization problems model hierarchical decision processes in which a leader anticipates the optimal response of a follower. Although expressive, these problems are computationally challenging because lower-level optimality is embedded in the leader's feasible region. Value-function reformulations replace the nested follower optimization with a constraint involving the follower's optimal value, but evaluating this value function exactly can itself be expensive. This paper introduces Graph4BiLO, a graph neural network (GNN) approach for learning bilevel value functions from variable--constraint graph representations. In contrast to fixed-length multilayer perceptron (MLP) representations, the GNN uses shared message-passing parameters and can therefore be applied across multiple problem sizes with a single trained model. translated_title: Graph4BiLO：面向双层混合整数线性优化的图神经网络逼近方法
translated_abstract: 双层混合整数线性优化问题对层级决策过程进行建模，其中领导者可以预判跟随者的最优响应。尽管这类问题具有很强的表达能力，但由于下层最优性被嵌入到领导者的可行域中，其计算极具挑战性。价值函数重构方法用涉及跟随者最优值的约束来替代嵌套的下层优化问题，但精确评估该价值函数本身可能代价高昂。本文提出Graph4BiLO，一种从变量—约束图表示中学习双层价值函数的图神经网络（GNN）方法。与固定长度的多层感知机（MLP）表示不同，GNN使用共享的消息传递参数，因此单个训练好的模型可以应用于多种不同规模的问题。学习到的ReLU网络被精确地编码为混合整数线性约束并嵌入……
tldr: 本文提出Graph4BiLO，利用图神经网络从变量—约束图表示中学习双层价值函数，使单一训练模型可泛化到不同规模的问题，并将学习到的ReLU网络精确编码为混合整数线性约束。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Graph4BiLO, a GNN approach that learns bilevel value functions from variable-constraint graph representations, enabling a single trained model to generalize across problem sizes and encoding the learned ReLU network exactly as mixed-integer linear constraints.
